name: contract-example-display
goal: Keep documented expectations for every selected helper case visible at its tested revision without borrowing sibling examples

evidence: Explorer helperDocumentation returns helper.examples before standardized testing.examples, and revision hydration ignores contract examples when a Markdown path exists. Selected helpers therefore hide supported expected results and error examples.

Strengthen the existing revision documentation case and helper selection case with legacy Markdown, canonical authored results, sibling isolation and expected errors. Keep their declarations unchanged; no standalone regression suite.

At 1973fe8bc0 the same three documentation cases and six catalog cases execute. The existing revision case loses finish: Finish and the existing helper-selection case loses Null count. Retained proof 0ddb9828ffe20f78cad61a15336ed139cee85816d3a684c100861f858bcc2877 contains both product-caused assertion diffs; no added test declarations.

Hydration retains exact revision Markdown and appends its authored canonical Examples. Selected helpers combine only their own helper-contract and canonical expected results/errors. The viewer model carries the same testing contract. Observed execution results never replace authored comments.
